remarks: 1877 Wolf Creek Road... Where 122.1 acres of fields, woods, ponds, trails, crops and a sprawling yard create a private country retreat with room to live, explore, and make your own. This spacious 5,500 sq. ft. home offers 5+ bedrooms and 2.5 baths, with a comfortable layout made for both everyday living and gathering with family and friends.  The heart of the home is a welcoming kitchen that's an open plan to living space while the main level also features formal dining, a cozy living room with a stone fireplace, built-in projection screen, and a sunroom with its own bar and lounge area that opens to the backyard. Upstairs, the oversized primary suite feels like a retreat of its own, complete with a walk-in closet, workout space, and access to a private balcony.  Outside is where this property really sets itself apart. With a 10-car barn, horse stalls, whole-house generator, wrapped driveway, multiple outbuildings, open acreage, wooded trails and ponds, there’s space here for hobbies, equipment, animals, recreation, or simply enjoying the peace and privacy of the land. Horses and livestock are permitted, adding even more possibilities.  Whether you picture a family retreat, hobby farm, hunting property, or simply a place to spread out and enjoy the outdoors from this amazing home and property, 1877 Wolf Creek Road offers a rare combination of space, privacy, and potential—all in the Portville School District.
